name: Tag Team Unleashed
description: Nirtom and Reps4Thor at full strength: every turn you pair them, Reps4Thor hits for 3.
play_style: Buy every Nirtom-named card and every Reps4Thor you see; they are the deck. Makeshift Lectern makes the pair cheap and Registration digs them back out of the discard. Nirtom Unleashed is a finisher, played alone or with Reps4Thor only.
combos: `Nirtom` + `Reps4Thor` in one turn: Reps4Thor deals 3.
`Nirtom Unleashed` may share a turn with `Reps4Thor`: +5 hacking, 2 damage, then 3 more.
`What is Truth?` has every name, so it counts as Nirtom for `Reps4Thor`.
`Super r0nk` adds hacking for each other Hero, and `Registration` returns a Hero to hand.

name: Token Ring Trio
description: 5ud0, bitwize and crook3dfingers ping each other; the market is built so you see them constantly.
play_style: Take the trio early and keep two of the three in hand: each one played with another deals 1 extra. Lectern and the free-Hero Fellowship turn the trio into a 3-hero turn. Registration and Speakers Needed recover them.
combos: `5ud0` + `bitwize` + `crook3dfingers`: each deals 1 when another of them is played.
`What is Truth?` counts as all three names for the trio's triggers.
`The Fellowship of the Token Ring` lets you buy FOTTR Heroes free and put Heroes in hand.
`Fore04` and `G4nd4lf` set up the next draw so the trio meets.
cards: The Fellowship of the Token Ring
Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365

name: Botnet Farm
description: Stack four Botnets and turn the hacking into an alternate win or a damage machine.
play_style: Race for Botnets: each one pays +1 per Botnet you control. Technology discounts (Tyler Crumpton, Hardware Hacking Village) make them nearly free. Spend surplus in Lowes Shopping Cart or Bribery.
combos: Four `Botnet` = +4 hacking each per turn.
`Tyler Crumpton` and `Hardware Hacking Village` cut `Botnet` to 1 hacking.
Surplus hacking goes into `Lowes Shopping Cart` (25 counters wins) or `Bribery`.

name: Mognet Mayhem
description: The Mog Variant engine: Mognet stacks while Mog-branded tech smooths the draw.
play_style: Same plan as a Botnet farm but in Mog colors: Mognets first, Mog Crumpton to discount technology, then Mog's Lowes Shopping Cart as the sink. Rookie Numbers punishes everyone holding Mog cards in their discard.
combos: Four `Mognet` = +4 hacking each per turn.
`Mog Crumpton` makes `Mognet` cost 1.
`Rookie Numbers` + `Mog's Lemon Custard Ice Cream`: draw 3.
cards: Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365@mog

name: Payphone Phreaks
description: Old-school phone phreaking: Payphones in play, Tone Whispers on top.
play_style: Get one Payphone down early; after that every Tone Whisperer is a 2-cost card dealing 3. Payphone Dave buys Payphones, You've Got Mail and Shell Speech for free. CTF Bangers makes Payphone damage hit 3.
combos: `Payphone` in play: `The Tone Whisperer` deals 3.
`Payphone Dave` buys `Payphone`, `You've Got Mail` or `Shell Speech` free.
`CTF Bangers` adds 1 to `Payphone` damage.

name: Never Gonna Rickroll
description: Rick Astley's greatest hits: paired songs strip hands and permanents.
play_style: Hold Never Gonna Give You Up until you have Never Gonna Let You Down (or What is Truth?) to play together. Rick Astley pushes Rickrolls into opponents' discards. Greatest Hits Volume 2 punishes anyone not playing Rick cards.
combos: `Never Gonna Give You Up` + `Never Gonna Let You Down`: opponents discard a permanent AND a card.
`What is Truth?` stands in for either song.
`Rick Astley` moves a `Rickroll` from your discard into an opponent's.
`F.O.T.T.R. Greatest Hits Volume 2` with plenty of `Rick Astley` around taxes 2 life per Rick-less turn.
cards: Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365

name: The O.P.R.A.H. Hour
description: You get a card, you get a card: thin your deck, then O.P.R.A.H. trades your hand for center deck cards.
play_style: Thin starters early with fred rogers, Elonka and evildagmar. Buy Flesh Oprah to get O.P.R.A.H. for free; PhreakNIC lowers Legendary prices. Late game, O.P.R.A.H. turns a hand of Hackers into fresh market cards.
combos: `Flesh Oprah` removes itself to buy `O.P.R.A.H.` free.
`PhreakNIC` makes `O.P.R.A.H.` and `Oprah Wonka` cost 2 less.
`O.P.R.A.H.` swaps Hackers in hand for center deck cards; `fred rogers` and `Elonka` thin the rest.

name: Clarion Inn Weekend
description: Check in at the Clarion: free Clarion buys, stolen Clarions, and walls of ICE.
play_style: Clarion Inn Staff makes every Clarion card free that turn, so buy Staff early and save the big Clarion Inn for a Staff turn. Under New Management steals Clarions from discards. Hotel Roof Chair Toss scales with all the locations.
combos: `Clarion Inn Staff` buys `The Clarion Inn` (8 ICE) for free.
`Under New Management` takes a Clarion card from any discard pile.
`Hotel Roof Chair Toss` deals 1 per Location you control.
`Randy` makes locations cost 1 less.

name: Soup and Sandwiches
description: Lunch at the con: The Sandwich Factory keeps getting re-ICEd while you snack your way to a life lead.
play_style: Land The Sandwich Factory and feed it with Egg in Your Soup and spare hacking. With a life lead, Corporate Retreat becomes a 2-damage hit. Hotel Roof Chair Toss turns the locations into damage.
combos: `Egg in Your Soup` adds 2 ICE to `The Sandwich Factory`.
`Hotel Roof Chair Toss` deals extra for each location.
Life from `Mog's Pancake Breakfast` keeps `Corporate Retreat` on its damage side.

name: Juice Box Heroes
description: The Juice ramps damage every turn, and the deck carries its own exits before the fifth counter.
play_style: Play The Juice early: 1, 2, 3, 4 damage per turn. _NASKEY doubles with Juice in play. Before the fifth counter, clear your own Juice with Talks Fun Police or Still Not Spock, or wipe the board with Clarion Inn Morning Coffee.
combos: `_NASKEY` deals and draws twice with `The Juice` in play.
`CTF Bangers` makes each `The Juice` tick 1 bigger.
`Talks Fun Police` or `Still Not Spock` discards your own `The Juice` before it kills you.

name: Damage Dealers Anonymous
description: No tricks, just damage: cheap hits and burst Heroes.
play_style: Buy damage every turn and point it at the weakest player. Drunk Riddler and Share a Link trade themselves for burst. Non-Infringing Game Show converts late hacking into damage.
combos: `Drunk Riddler` removes itself for 3 damage; `Share a Link` can remove itself for +2 hacking.
`Non-Infringing Game Show` spends up to 3 hacking for that much damage.
`heartsh8ped` and `Two Hump Camel` keep the hits cheap.

name: Martian Invasion
description: DeMartian and m8trix supercharge each other; the rest of the deck helps you find the pair.
play_style: Hold DeMartian until m8trix arrives: m8trix then deals 4 and DeMartian makes 4 hacking. Registration and Speakers Needed fetch Heroes. Makeshift Lectern and Super r0nk turn hero turns into big turns.
combos: `DeMartian` + `m8trix`: m8trix deals +2 and DeMartian makes +2.
`Registration` and `Speakers Needed` find the missing half.
`Super r0nk` adds hacking for every other Hero played.

name: Cardboard Cutout Convention
description: Every cutout at the con: reshape the Center Row until it shows what you need.
play_style: Use NotLarry Cardboard Cutout and Phreaknic Website Refresh to flush bad Center Rows and fish for your combo pieces; since the deck list is public, count what is left. Kevin Mitnick Cardboard Cutout keeps the cards flowing.
combos: `NotLarry Cardboard Cutout` swaps a Center Row card for a new one.
`Phreaknic Website Refresh` deals out a fresh Center Row and draws.
`Treasure Hunters` acquires an exact cost from the Center Deck.
`Phreaknic Website Refresh` then `NotLarry Cardboard Cutout`: wipe the row, then swap the one bad card left.
cards: Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365

name: Thin Mints
description: Remove your starters, then cash in removed cards for damage.
play_style: Spend the first turns thinning Hackers with fred rogers, Elonka, evildagmar and mog. F.O.T.T.R. Greatest Hits turns each removal into 2 damage. Clarion Inn Chandeliers brings back a removed card when you need it.
combos: `fred rogers` and `Elonka` remove Hackers for a tighter deck.
`F.O.T.T.R. Greatest Hits` removes a card from hand each turn for 2 damage.
`Clarion Inn Chandeliers` returns a removed card to your hand.

name: Jenny 867-5309
description: Call Jenny: pay up to 9 hacking for 9 damage, then bring her back.
play_style: Build a big hacking turn (Botnets, PhreakMyst) and dump it into Jenny for 9. Jenny removes herself, so Clarion Inn Chandeliers returns her to hand for another call.
combos: `Jenny` pays 9 hacking for 9 damage.
`Clarion Inn Chandeliers` returns `Jenny` after she removes herself.
`PhreakMyst` gives +6 on a no-buy turn: that's `Jenny` money.

name: Rookie Mog Hunt
description: Mog cards everywhere, so every Rookie Numbers hits every discard pile.
play_style: Nearly every card is a Mog printing, so everyone's discard soon has Mog cards in it, including yours; Rookie Numbers costs every such player 2 life. Plan to land more Rookies than your opponents.
combos: `Rookie Numbers` drains 2 from each player with a Mog card in their discard.
`Rookie Numbers` + `Mog's Lemon Custard Ice Cream`: draw 3.
`MogAlphaWolf` can remove itself to draw.

name: Hotel Fortress
description: Walls of ICE: out-last aggro and win late with Corporate Retreat.
play_style: Locations first: Candy Factory, The Clarion Inn and Walmart Parking Lot (free with heartsh8ped). Keep life high with The Big Dipper and Fiverr Friendship, then use Corporate Retreat for damage.
combos: `heartsh8ped` played this turn: buy `Walmart Parking Lot` free.
`Candy Factory` discards spare Heroes for more ICE.
`Randy` cuts location costs; `Corporate Retreat` punishes lower-life players.

name: Health Inspector
description: The health department is here: strip ICE and permanents, then burn.
play_style: Your damage is cheap, so the opponents' defense is the problem. Tennessee Department of Health removes ICE counters; AI Slop and Still Not Spock knock out permanents; Kevin's Desk takes their best one.
combos: `Tennessee Department of Health` strips ICE so `Elevator Noises` gets through.
`AI Slop` makes everyone discard a permanent and draws you a card.
`Kevin's Desk` steals a permanent every turn.

name: Fun Police State
description: Nobody gets to keep nice things: board wipes, hand attacks, and Nashville 2600.
play_style: Win by attrition. Talks Fun Police and Clarion Inn Morning Coffee clear permanents; Nashville 2600 locks them out entirely. The Reason and AI Ben's AI Camry empty hands. Your own damage comes from actions.
combos: `Nashville 2600` stops permanents; the deck's damage is actions like `Doom on a Trading Card`.
`AI Ben's AI Camry` turns spare hacking into opponent discards.
`Etch-a-Sketch Skillz` copies the best action in an opponent's discard.
cards: Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365

name: Extra Credit
description: Time Travel and The Book: take extra turns and replay actions.
play_style: Build hand size with draw, then land The Book: every turn it replays all attached actions. Time Travel gives an extra turn; time it for a lethal or a Book turn.
combos: `The Book` attaches an action every turn and replays all of them.
`Time Travel` removes itself for an extra turn.
`Tyler Crumpton` makes `Time Travel` and `The Book` cheaper.
cards: Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365

name: Shopping Cart Sprint
description: Fill a shopping cart with 25 counters and win the game outright.
play_style: Lowes Shopping Cart wins at 25 counters. Build hacking with Botnets, Mognets and phones, then dump it into the cart every turn. PhreakMyst's +6 is perfect: you can't buy, but you can fill the cart.
combos: `PhreakMyst` +6 hacking straight into `Lowes Shopping Cart`.
`Botnet` and `Mognet` each count only their own name, so pick one family.
`hardwarez` discards dead cards for extra hacking.

name: Life Coaches
description: Out-heal everyone, then let Corporate Retreat do the hitting.
play_style: Pile on life with Fiverr Friendship, The Big Dipper and breakfasts. Once ahead, Corporate Retreat deals 2 instead of healing. benthemeek can swing either way.
combos: `Corporate Retreat` deals 2 while you have more life; `Fiverr Friendship` keeps you ahead.
`BONY` gains 2 and buys `F.O.T.T.R. Greatest Hits` free.
`benthemeek` chooses +3 hacking, 3 life or 3 damage.
cards: Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365

name: Blood Pact
description: Everyone bleeds: symmetric life loss favors the player who planned for it.
play_style: r0nk and Clarion Inn Air Conditioning cost everyone life, Powered-On Taser Maintenance taxes Center Row buys, and proudF00F punishes Hackers in hand. Close fast with cheap damage.
combos: `proudF00F` makes each player lose 1 per Hacker in hand.
`Powered-On Taser Maintenance` costs opponents 1 life per Center Row buy.
`r0nk` + `Clarion Inn Air Conditioning`: everyone bleeds; be the one with damage.

name: Stamp Collector
description: Starter cards matter: Hackers deal damage and Attacks make hacking.
play_style: Dick Van Dyke Stamp makes every Hacker a damage card and every Attack a hacking card, so this deck keeps its starters instead of thinning. Cycle with Pooping in the Dark and Empty Lockpicking Table to replay them.
combos: `Dick Van Dyke Stamp`: each Hacker deals 1, each Attack gives +1.
`hfuller` gains life for every Attack revealed.
`CRT LAN Party` hits players whose top card is cheapest, often a starter.
`Dick Van Dyke Stamp` + `Pooping in the Dark`: redraw a hand of starters and every one does something.
cards: Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365

name: pTFS Bus
description: Ride the pTFS bus: bought Heroes return to your hand every turn.
play_style: Land pTFS: your pTFS Heroes are free and bought Heroes wait on it until your next turn. JousterL and G4nd4lf stack your next draw.
combos: `pTFS` lets you buy `JousterL`, `Venaul` and `Nuvious` free.
Heroes parked on `pTFS` come to hand next turn: buy `Kevin Mitnick Cardboard Cutout` and use it at once.
`Nuvious` discards an opposing permanent when bought.

name: Kevin's Heist
description: Why build when you can take? Steal permanents and copy opponents' actions.
play_style: Let opponents invest in permanents, then take them with AI Fingers and Kevin's Desk. Etch-a-Sketch Skillz copies their best action. The market has strong permanents so there is always something to take.
combos: `AI Fingers` takes control of the best permanent in play.
`Kevin's Desk` steals another permanent every turn.
`Etch-a-Sketch Skillz` copies an action from an opponent's discard.
`AI Fingers` on an opponent's `Payphone`: it now pays you every turn.

name: Lightning Round
description: Draw everything, then throw your hand at someone.
play_style: Lightning Talks, Bedtime Story and Where's Apache fill your hand, then Should have Preregistered removes the hand for 1 damage per card. F.O.T.T.R. Greatest Hits turns one card per turn into 2 damage.
combos: Draw with `Lightning Talks`, then `Should have Preregistered` removes the hand for 1 damage each.
`F.O.T.T.R. Greatest Hits` removes a card each turn for 2 damage.
`Errorgone` and `tipsybacchus` filter Hackers out.
cards: Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365

name: Budget Hackers
description: Nothing costs more than 3: every turn is a two-buy turn.
play_style: Everything is cheap, so buy two or three cards a turn. Botnets and Tableskirts snowball and Treasure Hunters picks an exact cost from the deck. Games are fast.
combos: Four `Botnet` at 2 each snowball quickly.
`Treasure Hunters` pays a cost and digs up the first card at that cost.
`Filler` replaces itself; `Tableskirts` is free hacking until you get another permanent.

name: Top Shelf
description: Nothing under 5: a slow, rich market where every buy matters.
play_style: Cards are expensive, so first-turn hacking decides who buys first. Hardware Hacking Village discounts the technology; John Titor shuffles back. Expect long games.
combos: `Hardware Hacking Village` makes `Bribery` and `Payphone` cheaper.
`F.O.T.T.R. Capture the Flag` (+3) funds big buys.
`TOCTOU Photo-Finish` saves you at 1 life with an extra turn.

name: Base Set Classic
description: Only Base Set cards: the original 2025 game with a curated market.
play_style: Plays like the original game with trimmed filler. Botnets and Payphones for economy, Elevator Noises and Share a Link for steady damage.
combos: `Payphone` + `The Tone Whisperer` for 3 damage.
`Nirtom` + `Reps4Thor` for 3 damage.
Four `Botnet` snowball.

name: Expansion One
description: Only Expansion 1 and its Mog printings: the 2026 cards on their own.
play_style: A newer-card environment: Makeshift Lectern heroes, pTFS, locations with ICE, and the Rookie Numbers Mog package.
combos: `Makeshift Lectern` discounts Heroes like `JousterL`.
`pTFS` buys `Venaul` and `JousterL` free.
`Rookie Numbers` + `Mog's Lemon Custard Ice Cream`: draw 3.

name: Mog Only
description: Every card is a Mog printing or Mog-named: the full Mog experience.
play_style: A Mog world. Mognet is the economy, Mog Fun Police the disruption, MOGTAU the safety net. Rookie Numbers hits everyone, since every discard pile fills with Mog cards.
combos: Four `Mognet` stack +4 a turn.
`Rookie Numbers` + `Mog's Lemon Custard Ice Cream`: draw 3.
`MOGTAU` saves you at 1 life with an extra turn.

name: Singleton Sampler A
description: One copy of nearly everything: every game shows a different market.
play_style: No combos to rely on, so value flexible cards: card draw, cheap damage and economy. Read the public list and count what is left: in a singleton deck each card you see is gone for good.
combos: `Payphone` + `The Tone Whisperer` if both appear.
`Nirtom` + `Reps4Thor` if both appear.

name: Legends Never Die
description: Two of every big Legendary, with PhreakNIC discounting them.
play_style: Economy first, then a Legendary a turn. PhreakNIC makes Legendaries 2 cheaper that turn; Makeshift Lectern also discounts Legendary Heroes.
combos: `PhreakNIC` makes `O.P.R.A.H.` or `Brimstone, Fabulous` 2 cheaper.
`Makeshift Lectern` stacks with `PhreakNIC` on `Super r0nk`.
`benthephreak` takes any Center Row card, including a Legendary.

name: Fellowship Free Lunch
description: The Fellowship of the Token Ring makes FOTTR Heroes free: build the whole crew.
play_style: Rush The Fellowship of the Token Ring; afterwards each FOTTR Hero is a free buy that goes to your hand. BONY makes Greatest Hits free.
combos: `The Fellowship of the Token Ring`: FOTTR Heroes like `cyberMonk3y` are free.
`BONY` buys `F.O.T.T.R. Greatest Hits` free.
`Fore04` goes on top of your deck when bought.

name: Singleton Sampler B
description: A hundred different cards: pure variety with no repeats.
play_style: Value flexible cards and count the public list as cards leave. Disruption is rare, so a strong permanent usually survives.
combos: `DeMartian` + `m8trix` if both show up.
`5ud0` + `bitwize` if both show up.

name: Singleton Sampler C
description: Almost every card once: the widest market in the collection.
play_style: Treat each card as unique. Market control (NotLarry Cardboard Cutout, Phreaknic Website Refresh) is strong when you're hunting a specific card.
combos: `NotLarry Cardboard Cutout` digs the Center Row for a key single.
`Treasure Hunters` acquires an exact cost from the Center Deck.
`Treasure Hunters` + `NotLarry Cardboard Cutout`: hunt one specific single in the deck or the row.

name: Highlander Heroes
description: One copy of every Hero, plus support.
play_style: Every Hero is unique, so tag-team and trio combos are rare and valuable. Lectern and Super r0nk reward hero-heavy turns.
combos: `Super r0nk` gains hacking for each other Hero played.
`Makeshift Lectern` makes every Hero 1 cheaper.
`Super r0nk` + `Makeshift Lectern`: cheap Heroes that each add hacking.

name: Two of Everything Economy
description: Two copies of every economy card: build an engine, then decide how to win.
play_style: Lots of +2 Heroes and permanents. Out-build opponents, then take the few damage cards in the market.
combos: `Tyler Crumpton` discounts `Botnet`.
`Payphone Dave` buys `Payphone` free.

name: Botnet vs Mognet
description: Two rival networks in one market, plus Botnet Takeover to wipe the Botnets.
play_style: Botnet and Mognet don't count each other, so commit to one family. Botnet Takeover wipes every Botnet in play but ignores Mognets; it's 2 damage when there are none.
combos: `Botnet Takeover` discards every `Botnet`; `Mognet` survives.
`Botnet` and `Mognet` each stack only with their own name.
`Tyler Crumpton` discounts both.

name: Payphone Network
description: A big phone-network market: Payphones, phones and phreakers.
play_style: Each Payphone gives +2 or 2 damage every turn. Get several down, protect them with ICE, and let The Tone Whisperer cash in.
combos: `Payphone` + `The Tone Whisperer`: 3 damage.
`Payphone Dave` buys `Payphone` free.
`CTF Bangers` adds 1 to `Payphone` damage.

name: Rick Roll Radio
description: FOTTR and Rick Astley on the radio: songs, rickrolls and Greatest Hits.
play_style: Pair the Never Gonna songs, keep Greatest Hits Volume 2 in play, and use BONY to grab Greatest Hits free.

name: Clarion Resort
description: Full-service Clarion with a wider market around it.

combos: `Clarion Inn Staff` makes `The Clarion Inn` free.
`Under New Management` steals a Clarion card from a discard pile.
`Clarion Inn Storage Closet` adds 2 ICE each turn.
cards: Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365

name: Exploit Engine
description: cyberMonk3y discounts Exploits; Foundation of Time pays damage per Exploit.
play_style: A market full of Exploits. cyberMonk3y makes them 1 cheaper; Foundation of Time/Temporal Reconstruction deals 1 per Exploit played. Chain several Exploits a turn.
combos: `cyberMonk3y` makes `Elevator Noises` cost 1.
`Foundation of Time/Temporal Reconstruction` adds 1 damage per Exploit.
`Never Gonna Give You Up` + `Never Gonna Let You Down` cost 1 less each with `cyberMonk3y`.

name: Foundation Builders
description: Foundation of Time/Temporal Reconstruction rewards a balanced mix of Heroes, Exploits and Events.
play_style: Rush Foundation: every Hero +1 hacking, Exploit 1 damage, Event 1 life. Then just play a lot of cards.
combos: `Foundation of Time/Temporal Reconstruction` + `Lightning Talks`: draw 2 and gain 1.
`PhreakNIC` makes Foundation 2 cheaper.
`Makeshift Lectern` discounts the Heroes.

name: Draw Go
description: Draw, defend, survive: the long game for patient players.
play_style: ICE and card draw. Military-Grade Card Encapsulation and TOCTOU Photo-Finish stop surprise lethal, then late burst wins.
combos: `Military-Grade Card Encapsulation` blocks all damage until your turn.
`TOCTOU Photo-Finish` saves you at 1 life and takes an extra turn.
`White Python Boots` turns spare hacking into cards.
`White Python Boots` + `Military-Grade Card Encapsulation`: draw into answers while you take no damage.

name: Tech Tree
description: Technology everywhere, discounted by Tyler Crumpton and Hardware Hacking Village.
play_style: Get discounts first, then a permanent engine. CTF Bangers makes damaging permanents hit harder.
combos: `Hardware Hacking Village` + `Tyler Crumpton`: Technology 2 cheaper.
`CTF Bangers` + `Bribery`: 2 damage per 2 hacking.
`Shell Speech` draws each turn.

name: Location Location Location
description: Every location: build a hotel empire.
play_style: Randy discounts locations, Hotel Roof Chair Toss turns them into damage, and [Restaurant Name] Restaurant copies the best one.
combos: `[Restaurant Name] Restaurant` copies `The Clarion Inn`.
`Hotel Roof Chair Toss` deals 1 extra per Location.
`Randy` makes locations 1 cheaper.

name: Damage Race
description: A big deck that is almost all damage: whoever hits first wins.
play_style: Defense is scarce. Every turn, buy damage; shift to cheap draw only when the Center Row is all expensive.
combos: `DeMartian` + `m8trix` when both appear.
`Drunk Riddler` removes for 3 damage.

name: Mog Mix
description: Original and Mog printings side by side: two of each.
play_style: Same rules, two printings, but Mog printings feed Rookie Numbers. Buy the originals when an opponent runs Rookies.
combos: `Rookie Numbers` hits players with Mog cards in their discard; originals don't count.
`Rookie Numbers` + `Mog's Lemon Custard Ice Cream`: draw 3.
`Tyler Crumpton` and `Mog Crumpton` both discount `Botnet`.

name: Cheap Thrills
description: Only cards costing 3 or less, in a deck large enough to be different every game.
play_style: Two buys a turn, every turn. Economy snowballs fast; damage decides it.
combos: Four `Botnet` snowball.
`heartsh8ped` + `Two Hump Camel`: steady damage for 1–3 hacking.

name: Con Crunch
description: PhreakNIC weekend: registration lines, talks, lecterns and the con network.
play_style: Event-heavy: Registration and Speakers Needed find Heroes, Makeshift Lectern discounts them, Lightning Talks draws. PhreakNIC is the big Legendary turn.
combos: `Registration` returns a Hero and draws.
`Speakers Needed` + `Makeshift Lectern`: find a Hero, play it cheap.
`Phreaknic Network` blocks a turn of damage, then deals 5.

name: Corporate Ladder
description: Climb the corporate ladder: retreats, reviews, swag and AI everything.
play_style: Life lead via Fiverr Friendship and SWAG tables, then Corporate Retreat for damage. The AI cards strip opponents' hands and boards.
combos: `Corporate Retreat` deals 2 when you're ahead on life.
`AI Ben's AI Camry` turns spare hacking into discards.
`Tips and tricks for Windows and Office365` lets you reserve and buy in one turn.
`Fiverr Friendship` + `Corporate Retreat`: buy life to stay ahead, then Retreat deals 2.

name: Phreak Week
description: Phreakers and phones: Ben the Phreak, PhreakMyst and the payphone crowd.
play_style: Phones for economy, benthephreak to take any Center Row card, PhreakMyst for a +6 no-buy turn.
combos: `benthephreak` acquires any Center Row card.
`Altk3y` can discard your `Unattended Phone` before its die roll costs you.

name: Reserve and Refresh
description: Control the market: reserve, refresh and acquire.
play_style: Tips and tricks lets you reserve even after buying; NotLarry Cardboard Cutout and Phreaknic Website Refresh cycle the Center Row; itsamenathan and Treasure Hunters acquire extra cards.
combos: `Tips and tricks for Windows and Office365` reserves a card after you buy.
`Phreaknic Website Refresh` deals a new Center Row.
`itsamenathan` acquires a card costing 4 or less.
`Phreaknic Website Refresh` + `Tips and tricks for Windows and Office365`: new row, then buy one card and reserve another.
cards: Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365

name: Grass Is Greener
description: Touch grass: nobody can buy, but you're the one with damage in hand.
play_style: Grass stops all buying until the end of your next turn. Play it when you're ahead in damage; Zenthere, Mind Goblin deals 2 when you acquire nothing.
combos: `Grass` stops all buying while `Zenthere, Mind Goblin` deals 2 for acquiring nothing.
`PhreakMyst` +6 on a no-buy turn pays for `Non-Infringing Game Show` damage.

name: Nashville Lockdown
description: Nashville 2600 bans permanents: an all-action deck.
play_style: Nashville 2600 discards all other permanents and stops new ones until someone pays 6. The deck is mostly actions, so the lock hurts opponents more.
combos: `Nashville 2600` wipes permanents; `Clarion Inn Morning Coffee` is the backup wipe.
`Lightning Talks` and `Kevin Mitnick Cardboard Cutout` keep you going without permanents.

name: Recycling Center
description: Nothing stays discarded: return, replay and recover.
play_style: Registration and Speakers Needed recover Heroes; G4nd4lf and JousterL stack your next draw; John Titor shuffles back in. Under New Management takes Clarions from discards.
combos: `G4nd4lf` puts a card from your discard on top when bought.
`John Titor` shuffles back into your deck.
`Clarion Inn Chandeliers` returns a removed card.
`Registration` returns a Hero to hand while `G4nd4lf` puts another discard card on top.

name: Hand Hate
description: Empty their hands: every turn the opponents discard.
play_style: The Reason, AI Ben's AI Camry and Never Gonna Let You Down make opponents discard. Doom on a Trading Card punishes their technology.
combos: `AI Ben's AI Camry`: 2 hacking per forced discard, as often as you like.
`Never Gonna Let You Down` + `Never Gonna Give You Up` makes each opponent discard.
`Doom on a Trading Card` discards per opposing Technology.

name: Super Friends
description: Cheap Heroes and Super r0nk: chain Heroes for big turns.
play_style: Lectern makes Heroes cheap; Super r0nk adds hacking for each other Hero. A 4-Hero turn buys anything.
combos: `Super r0nk` + three Heroes: +3 extra hacking.
`Makeshift Lectern` discounts every Hero.
`Registration` returns `Super r0nk`.

name: Big Botnet
description: A large economy market built around Botnet.
play_style: Botnets are only 4 of 130 cards, so grab them when seen and fill in with permanents.
combos: Four `Botnet` pay +4 each per turn; take every copy you see.
`Tyler Crumpton` makes `Botnet` and `Payphone` 1 cheaper this turn.
`Payphone` adds +2 or 2 damage every turn on top of the `Botnet` stack.

name: FOTTR Reunion Tour
description: The whole Fellowship plus a wide supporting cast.
play_style: Look for The Fellowship of the Token Ring and the trio; elsewhere play value.
combos: `5ud0` + `crook3dfingers` + `bitwize`: each deals 1 when another is played.
`The Fellowship of the Token Ring` makes `bitwize` and the other FOTTR Heroes free.
cards: The Fellowship of the Token Ring

name: Rickroll Festival
description: Rick Astley's festival: all the songs and rickrolls in a big market.
play_style: Rickrolls in the Center Row must be bought: watch them.
combos: `Never Gonna Give You Up` + `Never Gonna Let You Down`: a discard and a permanent discard for each opponent.
`Rick Astley` moves a `Rickroll` from your discard into an opponent's.
A `Rickroll` left in the Center Row must be bought at the start of a turn: leave it for the next player.

name: Payphone Empire
description: Payphones everywhere in a big permanent-rich market.

combos: `Payphone` in play: `The Tone Whisperer` deals 3.

`Shell Speech` draws each turn and can leave play for 2 damage.

name: Clarion Megaresort
description: Every Clarion card in a huge resort market.

`Under New Management` deals 2 and takes a Clarion card from any discard pile.

description: A huge Mog-first market.
